verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports 'Model selection: Choose specific Gemini models' (gemini-cli-gh-14), but this only allows switching between Google's own Gemini model variants, not across multiple external providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) as the story implies. Community complaints (gemini-cli-comm-3, gemini-cli-comm-19) also highlight confusing, siloed billing tied specifically to Google's ecosystem rather than flexible multi-provider access.
